source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U06: Apply fiduciary duties,accounts,retention,remuneration and reciprocal indemnities

payload.title: An agent accounts for both money and loyalty
payload.core_explanation_md:
The agent must follow the relevant directions,apply care and skill,communicate difficulties and render proper accounts. Secret profits,self-dealing and misuse of agency information are not excused merely because the principal received some benefit. The principal corresponding rights depend on the conduct and applicable remedy.

The agent also has legitimate rights:the described properly incurred expenses and due remuneration can be retained from receipts,and the applicable lien and completion rules need their contractual qualifications. Principal indemnity for the specified lawful or good-faith acts and compensation for principal neglect do not amount to unlimited cover for every unauthorised or unlawful act. Reconcile gross receipts,allowed retention and net remittance.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an agent earning a profit automatically mean the profit was authorised?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Disclosure,consent and the duty framework matter.

payload.stem_md: An agent remits the expected amount but secretly keeps an undisclosed benefit obtained through the agency. What remains relevant?

options.text_md: No duty exists if the principal received some money
options.explanation_md: Money remittance does not settle fiduciary compliance.

options.text_md: Every secret profit automatically belongs to the agent
options.explanation_md: The source identifies contrary principal rights.
Accounting includes the loyalty consequences of the transaction.

options.text_md: Only the date the agent opened a bank account
options.explanation_md: That does not resolve the conduct.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Accounting includes the loyalty consequences of the transaction.

payload.stem_md: An agent deducts personal unrelated spending from principal receipts as if it were a proper agency expense. Which reconciliation is needed?

options.text_md: Separate properly incurred expenses and due remuneration from unrelated amounts
options.explanation_md: The retention right has a defined basis.

options.text_md: Every expense claimed is automatically due
options.explanation_md: A label is not evidence of entitlement.

options.text_md: No agent may ever recover any expense
options.explanation_md: The source recognises legitimate expense rights.

options.text_md: The principal loses all money rights when an agent receives funds
options.explanation_md: Receipt in agency does not create unrestricted ownership.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The retention right has a defined basis.
